Mermaid 12.1.0 is bundled in `mermaid.js` for offline diagram rendering.
The bundle was built from the npm package with esbuild as an ES module.
`mermaid.js.LEGAL.txt` contains bundled dependency notices, and
`MERMAID.LICENSE` contains Mermaid's license.

`../mermaid.css` contains the neutral flowchart theme generated by Mermaid.
Serving it as a stylesheet keeps Vaultsh's existing Content Security Policy.
